description.narrative: The Development Objective is to increase the mobility possibilities for people and goods in Burkina Faso, in a socially, financially and economically sustainable fashion.

The Transport Sector Project for Burkina Faso aims to increase the mobility possibilities for people and goods in a socially, financially, and economically sustainable fashion. The project comprises two components: The first component focuses on institutional support and sectoral reforms while the second component invests in the road network improvement. Specifically, Component 1 strengthens planning, management, and monitoring capacities of transport sector-related institutions. It consists of five sub-components: 1) It strengthens the ministry in charge of the transport sector after the merging of the two ministries of transport and infrastructures. 2) To support the development of the private sector involved in transport services, it conducts a range of activities, spanning from sectoral regulation overhaul to direct support to the transport small and medium enterprises. 3) It focuses on all institutional activities aimed at improving the management of the road network. 4) It finances activities to strengthen the capacity of the General Directorate of Civil Aviation and Meteorology to supervise air transport security and safety. 5) It improves road safety and supports the newly created AIDS-dedicated cell, the Ministerial Committee Against AIDS. Component 2 rehabilitates main roads and provides funding for periodic road maintenance, as well as rehabilitating local government capital access roads and rural roads.
